book.name: 2Tasolonqe Asaas
book.title: Phawuloosi Tasolonqe Asaas Xaafida Nam7anththo Kiita

content: Ta ishatoo! Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa yuussaa gishshassinne nu izakko baana buussaa gishshas nu inttena qofsoos.
Ayanay qonccisides woykko qaalay gees giidi woykko nuuppe inttes kiitettida kiitaa mala, «Godaa yuussaa gallassi gakkides» giidi intte qofan yark yarkoftenne dagammofte.
Oonikka ay hanonkka inttena baleththofo. Daro asay ammano kaddanaappe sinththe dhayanaas bessiza issi makkalla asi qonccontta dishin he gallassay gakkenna.
Izikka Xoos geetetti goynnettiza eeqa xoossata ubbaafe bollara bana dhoqqu dhoqqu histtizaadenne Xoossara eqettizaade; izikka Xoossa Keeththan uttidi bana, «Tani Xoossa» giidi awajja awajjisana.
Ta inttenara diza wode hayta ha yo7ota inttes ta yootidayssi inttes qofettizeesha?
Izi ba woden qonccana gakkanaas ha7i izi qonccontta mala aazi diggizaakko intte ereeta.
Makkallanchcha xuuray haray attoshin ha7ikka ooso bolla dees; gido attiin hayssi hananay izi ha7i ooththontta mala iza diggizaadey iza ogeppe kichchana gakkanaas xalla.
Hessafekka kaallidi Godaa Yesusi ba doona peenoninne ba bonchcho yuussaan dhayssana; makkallanchchay qonccana.
He makkallanchcha yuussi Xala7e wolqqan hessika as baleththiza malaatataninne malalisiza miishshatan hanana.
Hessaththoka ekki attontta mala tumaa ixxidi dhayza asata baleththanaas dumma dumma iita oosoy yaana.
Hessa gaason istti wordo yo7o ammanana mala Xoossi istta bolla bala ooso kiittana.
Hessi hananay tumaa ammanontta ixxidi wordo yo7on ufayettizayti wuri pirdettanaassa.

Godaan dosettida ta ishatoo! Nu gidikko ubba wode intte gishshas Xoos galatanaas nuus bessees; gaasoykka Xoossi inttena koyroppe oykkidi intte Xillo Ayanan dummatidaytanne tumu ammanidi intte attana mala inttena doorides.
Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosi bonchcho gishettizayta intte gidana mala nu yootida mishiraachcho qaalaa baggara inttena xeygides.
Hessa gishshas ta ishatoo! Intte minni eqqite; nuni nu doonan gidiin woykko kiitan woykko nu inttes aaththi yeddida timirteza lo7eththi oykkite.
Izi nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosi qasse nuna siiqidaynne ba kiyateththan mernaa minththeththonne lo7o hidota izi nuus immida nu Aawaa Xoossay,
izi intte wozina lo7o oosoninne qaalan minththo.
